executive_summary: Full audit of the 13-file repository at HEAD 7db70af found one high-severity source-of-truth ambiguity. The PRD only requires restart persistence, but the EDD requires PostgreSQL 17 in every environment while its authoritative linked detail requires local JSON and forbids database/network access. The implementation follows the local-JSON branch. Tests were inspected but could not run because no Python installation was available.

findings.actual_behavior: The EDD hub declares PostgreSQL 17 mandatory in every environment, while the linked storage document independently declares local JSON mandatory and forbids database or network access. The structural-change log says both remain authoritative and that no semantics changed. src/store.py implements only the local-JSON branch.
evidence: docs/EDD.md:3-5 declares PostgreSQL 17 required in every environment and links the detailed storage specification as authoritative.
docs/architecture/storage.md:1-4 calls itself authoritative and requires local JSON with no database or network service.
docs/structural-change-log.md:3-4 states that both documents remain authoritative and that extraction changed no semantics.
src/store.py:1-11 (save/load) imports only json and pathlib and reads/writes a JSON file.
docs/milestones/m1.md:3 makes restart persistence depend on the approved EDD storage design.
findings.expected_behavior: The EDD hub and extracted detail should preserve one consistent approved storage decision, allowing M1 to be evaluated against an unambiguous design. The PRD intentionally leaves the storage engine open.
findings.recommended_action: Approve one storage contract—PostgreSQL 17 everywhere or local JSON with no database/network—and update the EDD, detailed storage document, structural-change log, M1, README, implementation, and tests consistently before accepting the milestone.
findings.title: Authoritative EDD documents disagree on the required storage architecture
findings.why_it_matters: The repository cannot determine whether the current implementation is compliant: local JSON satisfies the detailed document but violates the EDD hub, while PostgreSQL would violate the detailed document. Deployment requirements, architecture boundaries, and M1 acceptance are therefore undecidable.

milestone_status: Unable to assess. M1 requires use of the approved EDD storage design, but that design is unresolved. src/store.py:5-11 and tests/test_store.py:7-11 provide JSON persistence evidence only for the local-JSON interpretation.
prd_status: Compliant in reviewed scope. docs/PRD.md:3 requires persistence across restarts without selecting a storage engine; src/store.py:5-11 implements file-backed persistence and tests/test_store.py:7-11 asserts a save/load round trip. Runtime execution was not verified.
recommended_next_actions: Resolve and record the authoritative storage decision.
Synchronize EDD, detailed storage design, structural log, M1, README, implementation, and tests with that decision.
Restore an available Python runtime or CI runner and execute python -m unittest discover -s tests.
Reassess M1 acceptance after the storage contract is unambiguous.
